verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents official client SDKs for Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, and Ruby. Each provides idiomatic interfaces, type safety, and built-in streaming, retries, and error handling, and SDK version metadata is published as machine-readable JSON. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Client SDKs: General-purpose Messages API clients for Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, and Ruby. Each SDK provides idiomatic interfaces, type safety, and built-in support for streaming, retries, and error handling
